title: The Battle for Fort Greenwall (Imperial)
description: Legate Rikke orders the player to assist Imperial forces in assaulting Fort Greenwall, clearing it of Stormcloak rebels and securing the Rift for the Empire.

base_facts: I am Legate Rikke, commanding Imperial forces in the Rift from the Rift Imperial Camp.
I report to General Tullius and coordinate Imperial military operations in this hold.

QUEST_STARTED: I have sent the soldier to rendezvous with Imperial troops and assist in taking Fort Greenwall from the Stormcloaks.
FORT_CAPTURED: Fort Greenwall has been taken from the Stormcloaks, securing the Rift for Imperial control.
Maven Black-Briar will be installed as Jarl of Riften, replacing Laila Law-Giver as the Empire consolidates its hold on the Rift.
Legate Rikke offers a leveled gold reward for the successful capture of the fort.
The Reunification of Skyrim campaign continues; Rikke will assign the next Imperial military objective upon the soldier's return.

beats.comment: Player reports to Legate Rikke at the Rift Imperial Camp and receives orders to take Fort Greenwall.
Player joins the Imperial soldiers preparing the assault on Fort Greenwall.
Fort Greenwall is taken from the Stormcloaks. The Rift falls to Imperial control. Quest completes.
